nmap.raw_help_excerpt:
Nmap 7.94SVN ( https://nmap.org )
Usage: nmap [Scan Type(s)] [Options] {target specification}
SCAN TECHNIQUES:
  -sS/sT/sA/sW/sM: TCP SYN/Connect()/ACK/Window/Maimon scans
  -sU: UDP Scan
  -sn: Ping Scan - disable port scan
  -Pn: Treat all hosts as online -- skip host discovery
SERVICE/VERSION DETECTION:
  -sV: Probe open ports to determine service/version info
  -sC: equivalent to --script=default
  -O: Enable OS detection
  -A: Enable OS detection, version detection, script scanning, and traceroute
PORT SPECIFICATION:
  -p <port ranges>: Only scan specified ports
  --top-ports <number>: Scan <number> most common ports
  -F: Fast mode - Scan fewer ports than the default scan
TIMING AND PERFORMANCE:
  -T<0-5>: Set timing template (higher is faster)
OUTPUT:
  -oN/-oX/-oS/-oG <file>: Output scan in normal, XML, s|<rIpt kIddi3, and Grepable format

dig.raw_help_excerpt:
Usage:  dig [@global-server] [domain] [q-type] [q-class] {q-opt}
        {global-d-opt} host [@local-server] {local-d-opt}
Where:  q-opt    is one of:
                 -4                  (use IPv4 query transport only)
                 -6                  (use IPv6 query transport only)
                 -p port             (specify port number)
                 -q name             (specify query name)
                 -t type             (specify query type)
                 -x dot-notation     (shortcut for reverse lookups)
        d-opt    is of the form +keyword[=value], where keyword is:
                 +[no]short          (Control nada/short output)
                 +[no]trace          (Trace delegation down from root)
                 +[no]dnssec         (Request DNSSEC records)

valid_flags.+answer: Display the answer section of a reply
